flows.name: rca-plan
flows.description: Plan stage: turns a new issue into a scoped plan that respects the citation gates (ro-cited-answers).

flows.name: rca-review
flows.description: Create/verify stage: gate-aware merge request review. Asks the one question that matters: can this change make the system answer what it used to refuse?

flows.name: rca-fix
flows.description: Verify stage: when a pipeline fails, reads the failing jobs and opens a fix merge request (never touches the gates).

flows.name: rca-secure
flows.description: Secure stage: triages SAST, secret and container findings by reachability and opens a base-image merge request. Dismisses nothing itself.

flows.name: rca-release
flows.description: Release/monitor stage: after a deploy on main, checks the live service and posts the release summary; on a failed promote or monitor run, opens an incident.
